procedure: The phone had been previously reset to factory defaults, including a wipe of the device. iOS 16.1.2 was installed.
A Google Fi account was added in order to apply cellular service to the device.
Fifty-five (55) third-party apps were installed from the AppStore and populated with user data based on each app's respective capabilities.
Stock iOS apps were populated with user data based on each app's respective capabilities.
An extraction was performed using Cellebrite UFED.
The phone was updated to iOS 17.3.
Additional data was generated in both 3rd party and native applications.
A second extraction was performed using Cellebrite UFED.
